query:
UPDATE skus SET
             code       = COALESCE($2, code),
             name       = COALESCE($3, name),
             options    = COALESCE($4, options),
             weight_g   = COALESCE($5, weight_g),
             active     = COALESCE($6, active),
             position   = COALESCE($7, position),
             updated_at = now()
         WHERE id = $1
